record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; code and evidence files were not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: Tests a weight-edit transplant by measuring harmful-prompt responses against the stock checkpoint, rather than applying the original difference-in-means direction ablation.
record.gate_note: The README reports a stock-versus-transplant comparison on the same first 100 strong_reject prompts. The speed measurements do not measure refusal or general capability. Other results mentioned in the README are not needed for the claim versions tested here.
record.test_reason: It applies a released abliteration weight edit (donor o_proj tensors) to a quantized GLM-5.3-Flash checkpoint. It then measures strong_reject refusals against the stock checkpoint, which bears on V2 in a new model and setting. T3 rather than T2, because the edit is itself described as abliteration, not a different method.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The README reports the transplant answers 73 of 100 harmful strong_reject prompts versus 4 for stock, under the same (non-independent) judge. It reports decode speed near stock. It states that quality, over-refusal and an external judge remain to be measured.
record.recipe_differences: A weight transplant replaces self_attn.o_proj.weight tensors in layers 15-44 with donor checkpoint tensors; it does not report using the original difference-in-means direction ablation. This is a tool/repository that builds a local edited checkpoint, not an explicit replication.
record.problems: The refusal comparison uses only the first 100 of 313 prompts, and the README says the judge is not independent. Stock answers were generated on recipe v1.3 while transplant answers were generated on v1.2. No uncertainty is reported for the refusal results. Quality and over-refusal were not measured.
record.rows_left_out: No README-reported results bearing on the claim were left out; the speed measurements are not refusal or capability outcomes.

untested.parts: Preservation of other abilities: quality on GSM8K and HumanEval was not measured, nor was over-refusal on xstest. Only one checkpoint and the first 100 of 313 prompts were tested. The edit's derivation (difference-in-means or otherwise) is not described.
No direction is computed, ablated or added.
Not tested. Transfer of donor tensors across quantizations is applied by construction, not tested.
Not tested. reasoning_effort was set to low but not varied.

record.verdict_notes: This is a GitHub tool repository, not a paper. The refusal evidence is a single README table, and evidence/refusals.json was not read. The speed results do not bear on any version. Stock rows r1-r3 are baselines, and their 'absent' state just reflects the stock model refusing.

versions.untested_parts: Does not test a difference-in-means direction, its removal or addition, or effects on other abilities.
Tests one transplant on one checkpoint only; does not establish that weight edits remove refusal in other released models. Quality and over-refusal were not measured.
Does not test attacks suppressing the direction or training against its ablation.
Does not compare one direction with an affine, cone, or multi-direction account.
Does not separate harmfulness judgments from refusal decisions.
Does not test transfer across languages, model variants, or base-to-instruct models.
Does not compare refusal-training methods or stages.
Does not test whether the direction holds in models that reason before answering.

statements.correction: gh:eleata: Dealign o_proj transplant (layers 15-44 change) on Mia-AiLab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-TR3-4bpw. Answered 73/100 strong_reject prompts vs 4/100 stock; jailbreak_rate 0.73 vs 0.04; metric 3.40 vs 0.19 (0-5). 27/100 still refused. Judge = transplanted model; stock on recipe v1.3, transplant on v1.2. Not tested: a full-layer edit, or which layers matter. Fits limits_scope (incomplete removal), not challenges.
statements.problem: The numbers for this study are right: layers 15-44, EXL3 4bpw, 73/100 vs stock 4. The reading is wrong, though. The study is filed under 'challenges' with 'leave refusal intact', but refusal mostly went away. The study's own verdict is limits_scope. The study has no full-layer comparison, and nothing in it attributes the remaining refusal to the edit being confined to some layers. The README never gives GLM-5.3-Flash's size.

statements.correction: gh:eleata r4: replaces the self_attn.o_proj.weight tensors of layers 15-45 (31 tensors) with those of dealignai/GLM-5.3-Flash-UNCENSORED-NVFP4 at revision 745aac2f. Layer 45 equals stock, so layers 15-44 change. The README does not state the donor edit's method (direction count or projection).
statements.problem: The repo does copy donor tensors rather than compute a direction. But the README never says how Dealign made the donor edit, so the text can't show it isn't a difference-in-means projection. 'Single-matrix' is also misleading: one matrix type is replaced in each of 31 layers.
